title: Carl-Benz-Straße, Rosbach vor der Höhe
description:
Modern 1-Bedroom Apartment in Rosbach – Great Location Near Frankfurt

Welcome to your comfortable home away from home in Rosbach, just a short drive from Frankfurt! This modern and well-equipped 1-bedroom apartment is perfect for solo travelers, commuters, or business guests seeking a convenient and cozy stay.

Enjoy a bright and welcoming living/sleeping area featuring a comfortable single bed, a spacious wardrobe, a desk for working or studying, and a cozy seating area. The apartment includes a private bathroom with a shower and WC, plus a fully equipped kitchenette with a stovetop, microwave, and kettle — ideal for preparing your own meals during your stay.

✔️ Smart-TV & high-speed internet
✔️ Allergy-friendly carpet flooring
✔️ Weekly cleaning included
✔️ Air conditioning & underfloor heating
✔️ Secure, video-monitored parking
✔️ Optional: Access to washing machine and dryer (paid service)

Set in the peaceful town of Rosbach, the apartment offers quick and easy access to Frankfurt — perfect for both work and leisure. Local shops and transport links are nearby, making daily errands a breeze.

We're happy to host you and look forward to welcoming you soon! 😊
